channel.title: Brazil Procurement HOT
channel.description: Government tenders from Brazil's national procurement portal PNCP across eight categories — health, education, works, transport, food, IT, services and supplies. Titles and one-line summaries are rewritten in our own words, with links to the official notices, updated every 30 minutes.

item.description: A public buyer in Astorga (PR) is procuring professional or outsourced services through electronic pregão (reverse auction), with an estimated value of about R$ 161.50; proposals close Dec 2, 08:29 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
